name: agent-deathmatch
description: Kill time in a robot deathmatch while Codex works, then return when your task finishes.

interface.longDescription: Fight as a Codex-themed robot in a shared deathmatch, with bots while alone. A paired local companion watches supported local and cloud Codex tasks. When a task finishes, see your personal scoreboard for five seconds and return to Codex. This package integrates Codex; a companion Claude Code package is available separately.
